text: Unlocks [[img:icon_hero]][[/img]]Legendary Hero: [Guardian of the Wall] Yang Xing
Touch the Radiant Star Divine Sword
Touch the Dark Peak Heavy Shield

The earth rumbles as [Guardian of the Wall] Yang Xing strides forth. Wielding the Dark Peak Heavy Shield and raising the Radiant Star Divine Sword high, he fights for your ranks, nobly defending the Celestial Empire of Cathay. Beyond you and the other sentinels under your command, the entire realm of the dragon gods shall find shelter behind his form... but who is to receive this blessing is for you to decide.

Legend tells of a giant who guards the Eastern Empire deep within the Long Wall, keeping close watch over the trials and tribulations endured by the dragon gods. It is said that Yang Xing was the first sentinel forged by the Dragon Emperor, foremost among the Four Legendary Sentinels. Whenever soldiers fighting for the welfare of the Celestial Empire of Cathay display unyielding valor, the shield-bearing sentinel known as the Steadfast Commander appears - and it is then that we may witness the greatest of the towering sentinels...

The ancient constructs of the Celestial Empire of Cathay are the wellspring of its mighty power. Now the great force of life fills these once-lifeless colossal statues, letting them play a pivotal role within the armies of the dragon gods. Every particle within these entities is miraculously bound together, inside and out: whether of stone, jade, or obsidian, all lions and sentinels share an unyielding and profound bond. As more of these construct warriors join your army, the mightiest of their kind shall be awakened...
